glossary.conformal_range_desc: Statistically guaranteed 90% confidence interval under split-conformal regression UQ, ensuring actual rainfall falls within this band 9 out of 10 times.
glossary.mint_desc: Minimum Trace hierarchical forecast reconciliation. Projects independent Panchayat predictions onto the linear subspace of the official IMD Block baseline so they sum perfectly.
glossary.csi_desc: Evaluates heavy rainfall event prediction skill. A CSI of 0.92 indicates high hit rate and very low false alarm ratio.
glossary.mae_desc: Average magnitude of forecast errors in mm. MAE reduction shows percentage error reduction compared to flat block forecasts.
glossary.residual_desc: The local rainfall adjustment in mm driven by micro-topography (elevation, slope, wind aspect) added to the coarse block baseline.
glossary.downscaling_desc: Refining coarse 10-25 km IMD block forecasts down to 1 km² Panchayat resolution using high-resolution SRTM 30m digital elevation.
